record.paper_title: Some open problems in dynamical systems
record.context_brief: Analytic perturbation with sparse periodic orbits
record.original_question: Let H_0(r) be a real-analytic strictly convex Hamiltonian on T^*T^n = T^n × R^n, with superlinear growth at infinity and ∂H_0/∂r(0) = 0. Can one find a real-analytic family H_ε(θ,r) = H_0(r) + ε H_1(θ,r,ε) and a small ε_0 such that, on the energy level H_{ε_0}^{-1}(1), the periodic orbits of the Hamiltonian flow are not dense?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and consider the cotangent bundle $T^*\mathbb{T}^n = \mathbb{T}^n\times\mathbb{R}^n$ with canonical coordinates $(\theta,r)$. Let $H_0:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ be a real-analytic, strictly convex function (i.e. its Hessian is positive definite everywhere) with superlinear growth at infinity ($H_0(r)/|r|\to\infty$ as $|r|\to\infty$) and satisfying $\partial H_0/\partial r(0)=0$. Determine whether there exists a real-analytic family of Hamiltonians
$$H_\varepsilon(\theta,r) = H_0(r) + \varepsilon\, H_1(\theta,r,\varepsilon),$$
with $H_1$ real-analytic in $(\theta,r,\varepsilon)$, and a sufficiently small $\varepsilon_0>0$ such that on the energy level $H_{\varepsilon_0}^{-1}(1)$ the set of periodic orbits of the Hamiltonian flow of $H_{\varepsilon_0}$ is not dense.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a version of Herman's conjecture on density of periodic orbits for analytic perturbations of convex integrable Hamiltonians. A search located Garay's preprint discussing "the Herman conjecture" and related KAM-type results, but no complete resolution of this density question appears in the literature; it is still cited as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Herman Conjecture (Garay)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Herman's invariant tori conjecture and related formulations for periodic orbits without resolving the density question.
status_evidence.claim: Herman's conjecture concerning density properties for analytic convex Hamiltonian perturbations is treated as an open problem in the dynamical systems literature.

status_evidence.title: Periodic orbits and global surfaces of section in Hamiltonian systems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey notes on periodic orbits in Hamiltonian systems referencing Herman's question on density of periodic orbits.
status_evidence.claim: The density of periodic orbits for analytic perturbations of convex integrable Hamiltonians remains an open question.
